method: Read RULES.md/TAXONOMY.md; atomscan slow and cleave facts on all supplied paths; PE structures/imports, Rizin and Capstone control/data-flow review; embedded-image isolation; independent positive and benign controls; complete per-unit rescan diffs. No specimen was executed.

evidence: 0x401150 creates a child, allocates a DLL-path buffer in it, writes the path, resolves LoadLibraryA and supplies that address and buffer to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
0x401260 builds a System32 DLL path, opens HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters, deletes ServiceDLL and rewrites it as REG_EXPAND_SZ at 0x40133e.
The Active Setup branch creates an Installed Components GUID subkey and writes StubPath at 0x401a4b, then reads/patches/writes a self-copy using CRT streams.
0x401390 obtains the current module and its short path, obtains COMSPEC, builds /c del <self> > nul and invokes CreateProcess.
0x402460 extracts a resource and passes its bytes and length to the WriteFile helper at 0x4023c0. These surviving code paths, alongside the family banners, establish malicious loader intent.
samples.marker: StormAttack loader: DLL hijack, injection and self-delete code

samples.identification: Avzhan-style native Windows DDoS and spreading worm
evidence: The socket receive/command dispatcher near 0x407b29 reaches system("shutdown -r -t 0 -f") at 0x407f07 and download/execute and attack-worker branches.

The security-process helper at 0x408572 enumerates PROCESSENTRY32 names, compares target names and passes selected process handles to TerminateProcess. Calls at 0x4086ef onward target KSafeTray, KSWebShield and kislive.

0x406b98 advances independent username and password arrays and calls 0x406bed. That helper resolves WNetAddConnection2A, constructs an IPC$ resource, and supplies the candidate pair to the resolved function.
The same spread helper copies its module through C$/D$/E$/F$/admin$ and formats an at \\host time payload command before WinExec at 0x406eaf.

0x406ed6 classifies drives; 0x407135 writes AutoRun open/shell entries and copies its image into a drive-root recycle-directory disguise. HTTP workers use browser GET templates and repeated socket sends. These are attack functions, not an antivirus engine.
samples.marker: Avzhan worm: AV killing, HTTP floods and SMB/drive spreading

samples.identification: NetWire RAT embedded in a decompressed AutoIt/CAPE carrier
evidence: The 180224-byte PE at file offset 0x10a4d4 is a separate native NetWire payload with its own import table and coherent control flow.
The raw-input window procedure near 0x40e12e handles WM_INPUT, requests RID_INPUT, selects keyboard records and key-down/system-key-down messages, and calls 0x40db3b with the virtual key.

0x40db3b queries modifier state and translates keys with ToAscii/GetKeyNameTextA. The resulting buffer is passed at 0x40e110 to 0x40d74c, which records a timestamped session and scrambles that same buffer via 0x40d70c before WriteFile. The byte transformation is ((byte XOR 0x9d)+0x24) mod 256.
0x40da18 records the foreground-window title with timestamps. This is message-driven raw-device keylogging; GetKeyState here does not establish a polling acquisition loop.

0x417e8c creates two pipes, supplies their handles to a hidden child through STARTUPINFO and CreateProcessA at 0x4180fe, reads output and returns typed response 0xb7 through packet sender 0x408b8f. Dispatcher input at 0x40247e reaches the pipe writer at 0x418352.

0x40b60e constructs a 64-character alphabet on the stack and substitutes each character by rotating its alphabet index by six. CONNECT/Host proxy fields and special-key labels decode through this helper. This is substitution, not Base64 packing or proof of HTTP C2.
Covert input recording, scrambled logs and remote command execution in the embedded payload tip the verdict toward malicious despite the general-purpose AutoIt runtime surrounding it.
samples.marker: NetWire RAT: covert keylogging; correct runtime API claims

limitations: No deployment authorization, endpoint telemetry or successful C2 connection was supplied. Verdicts use static behavior and packaging, not collector filenames, ML scores or engine vote counts.

The StormAttack resource DLL at 0x5060 retains data but has erased imports and zeroed code/entry bytes; its raw range 0x1600..0x7400 is entirely zero. Stale bound IAT contents and hard-coded self-patch offsets also limit execution claims. Existing traits deliberately describe surviving loader code. No new DDoS detection was invented for this erased payload.
The Avzhan resource member at 0xa110 is a screensaver-library PE and has no hostile/suspicious findings. It is not a second RAT merely because it is embedded.

The NetWire carrier has populated UPX0, an entry in existing native code and a CAPE dump section. UPX reports NotPackedException. UPX labels prove neither a currently packed image nor injection. The original AutoIt script chain was not fully reconstructed; the intact native payload supplies independent hostile evidence.
No demonstrated Agent Tesla, Maze, Remcos, WannaCry or ransomware behavior was inferred from the filenames.

corrections.unsupported_claim: Imports and UPX labels do not bind script bytes to remote execution or an HTTP C2 channel. Official AutoIt exposes the same remote-memory, WinInet and process APIs.
corrections.retained: All required/alternative conditions, needs, effective type/platform/size scope and exclusions are identical; only the claim, home, criticality and unsupported attack mappings change.

corrections.unsupported_claim: Resource enumeration, temporary-file, WriteFile and ShellExecute imports establish no resource-to-file-to-launch data flow or hostile intent.
corrections.retained: Same matcher and scope; neutral resource-enumeration API profile remains notable.

corrections.unsupported_claim: FTP, ICMP, user-profile and share imports also occur in the official AutoIt interpreter; their co-occurrence is not NetWire identity, lateral transfer or proof of packing.
corrections.retained: Same matcher, scope and exclusions; notable API profile retained. Both discriminating NetWire family detections stay hostile.

consumer_audit: No exact-ID consumers of the moved rules existed. All ancestor selectors were enumerated.

The CrystalX command-and-control exclusion retains the two moved observation populations through its existing named notable-observation exception group, without an over-budget expanded direct suppression list.
The Python staged-loader and security-hosts sinkhole consumers retain the moved resource profile by exact ID. Their unrelated source/target legs are unchanged.

The new memory member cannot satisfy the PowerShell-only Empire consumer on a PE. The FTP directory consumer requires only one alternative and already admitted the required wininet-ftp-api atom, so its population does not broaden.

The substitution loop has its direction-neutral scheme home in data/encoding/substitution, separately from Base64 bit packing and compression codecs. No compression-library consumer inherits the new observation.

Collection ancestor consumers use independent webhook/vendor/identity gates; the new keylogger code has no such companion evidence in this batch. New SMB credential-loop membership has no ancestor selector consumers.

controls.outside_batch_result: The independently reviewed Elex fixture retains its rundll32 staging/identity hostile detections; the official runtime matches neither new behavior detector. A separate static near miss changes only vendor-runtime section labels and signature/version metadata; all three relocated API profiles remain notable, with no hostile/suspicious finding. This near miss supplements the actual benign runtime, not a reason to erase a technique.

external_reports: All three supplied tria.ge pages were inaccessible through the web tool. Their sandbox scores and VT vote counts were not used to establish behavior.
outcome: No accurate attack detection was lost. Three unsupported hostile claims on the NetWire carrier were replaced with the exact same notable API observations. Raw-input keylogging, direction-neutral alphabet substitution and the SMB credential-pair loop gained detections. All three classifiers remain HOSTILE; no remaining sample-verdict disagreement.
acceptance_command: make validate (required final action after judgement markers)
